title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ldv2: CBOR sequence used instead of CBOR array for all transcript hash inputs
description:
Throughout edhoc.py, TH_2_input, TH_3_input, and TH_4_input are constructed as CBOR sequences (concatenation of individually encoded items) rather than as CBOR arrays as required by RFC 9528.

Affected lines and their corrections:

TH_2 (initiator, line 388):
  Current: cbor2.dumps(g_y) + cbor2.dumps(h_msg1)
  Should be: cbor2.dumps([g_y, c_r, h_msg1])

TH_2 (responder, line 597):
  Current: cbor2.dumps(self._eph_pk) + cbor2.dumps(h_msg1)
  Should be: cbor2.dumps([self._eph_pk, self.c_r, h_msg1])

TH_3 (initiator, lines 418-422):
  Current: cbor2.dumps(self._th_2) + cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_2) + cbor2.dumps(id_cred_r)
  Should be: cbor2.dumps([self._th_2, ciphertext_2, id_cred_r])

TH_3 (responder, lines 620-624):
  Current: cbor2.dumps(self._th_2) + cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_2) + cbor2.dumps(id_cred_r)
  Should be: cbor2.dumps([self._th_2, ciphertext_2, id_cred_r])

TH_4 (initiator, line 443):
  Current: cbor2.dumps(self._th_3) + cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_3)
  Should be: cbor2.dumps([self._th_3, ciphertext_3])

TH_4 (responder, line 677):
  Current: cbor2.dumps(self._th_3) + cbor2.dumps(ciphertext_3)
  Should be: cbor2.dumps([self._th_3, ciphertext_3])

Per RFC 9528, transcript hash inputs are CBOR arrays (denoted by brackets [...] in the spec), not CBOR sequences. The concatenation-of-individually-encoded-items produces different bytes than a proper array encoding, causing incorrect transcript hashes on all three rounds (TH_2, TH_3, TH_4).

Note: the same CBOR sequence pattern appears in other context constructions (context_2 at line 408, context_3 at line 428) which should also be reviewed for array encoding.
